metadata.question: In September 2023, did Cabo Frio have a sea zone of a temperature graident over 5 degrees Celcius over less than 10 kilometers?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Cabo Frio, Brazil (coastal city, ~-22.88°S, -42.02°W) - Time: September 2023 (full month) - Collection: Sea Surface Temperature - MODIS Aqua or Terra, or NOAA SST products - Need to find temperature gradients in offshore zones 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for SST products (they're already processed) - Focus on valid SST pixels in the ocean near Cabo Frio 3. Logic: - Create a coastal transect/zone near Cabo Frio - Calculate temperature gradient: if we have >5°C change over <10km distance, answer is Yes (A) - Check for valid data (C1: no images, C2: no valid pixels, C3: calculation failure) - Sample SST along transects perpendicular to coast to detect sharp gradients (upwelling fronts are common here) 4. Approach: - Use MODIS SST (11 micron day) or NOAA SST - Create sampling points along transects - Calculate temperature differences between nearby points (<10km apart) - Check if any gradient exceeds 5°C over that distance ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const caboFrio = ee.Geometry.Point([-42.02, -22.88]); const searchArea = caboFrio.buffer(20000); // 20km radius for sea zone const startDate = '2023-09-01'; const endDate = '2023-09-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try MODIS Aqua SST first let sstCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(searchArea) .select('sst'); let colSize = sstCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('MODIS Aqua SST Images: ' + colSize); if (colSize === 0) { // Try NOAA SST as backup sstCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(searchArea) .select('sst'); colSize = sstCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('NOAA SST Images: ' + colSize); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No SST data found for September 2023.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Create composite to analyze const sstMean = sstCol.mean(); // 4. Sample along transects perpendicular to coast (offshore direction) // Cabo Frio is known for upwelling - cold water near coast, warm offshore const coastPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-42.02, -22.88]); // Near coast const offshore5km = ee.Geometry.Point([-41.97, -22.88]); // ~5km offshore const offshore10km = ee.Geometry.Point([-41.92, -22.88]); // ~10km offshore const offshore15km = ee.Geometry.Point([-41.87, -22.88]); // ~15km offshore // Sample temperatures const samplingPoints = ee.FeatureCollection([ ee.Feature(coastPoint, {name: 'coast'}), ee.Feature(offshore5km, {name: 'off5km'}), ee.Feature(offshore10km, {name: 'off10km'}), ee.Feature(offshore15km, {name: 'off15km'}) ]); const samples = sstMean.sampleRegions({ collection: samplingPoints, scale: 1000, geometries: true }); const sampleList = samples.toList(10).getInfo(); if (sampleList.length === 0) { console.log('No valid SST pixels in sampling area.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Extract temperatures and check gradients const temps = {}; for (let i = 0; i < sampleList.length; i++) { const feature = sampleList[i]; const name = feature.properties.name; const temp = feature.properties.sst; temps[name] = temp; console.log(name + ' SST: ' + (temp !== null ? temp.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null')); } // Check if we have valid temperatures const validTemps = Object.values(temps).filter(t => t !== null && !isNaN(t)); if (validTemps.length < 2) { console.log('Insufficient valid temperature data.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Calculate gradients over different distances let maxGradient = 0; let gradientDistance = 0; if (temps.coast !== null && temps.off5km !== null) { const grad5 = Math.abs(temps.coast - temps.off5km); console.log('Gradient 0-5km: ' + grad5.toFixed(2) + '°C'); if (grad5 > maxGradient) { maxGradient = grad5; gradientDistance = 5; } } if (temps.off5km !== null && temps.off10km !== null) { const grad10 = Math.abs(temps.off5km - temps.off10km); console.log('Gradient 5-10km: ' + grad10.toFixed(2) + '°C'); if (grad10 > maxGradient) { maxGradient = grad10; gradientDistance = 5; } } if (temps.coast !== null && temps.off10km !== null) { const grad10total = Math.abs(temps.coast - temps.off10km); console.log('Gradient 0-10km: ' + grad10total.toFixed(2) + '°C'); if (grad10total > maxGradient && grad10total / 10 > maxGradient / gradientDistance) { maxGradient = grad10total; gradientDistance = 10; } } console.log('Max gradient: ' + maxGradient.toFixed(2) + '°C over ' + gradientDistance + 'km'); // 6. Final Answer if (maxGradient > 5 && gradientDistance <= 10) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
